Chaetoderma nitidulum

CaudofoveataSpecies entry 10 of 593 in taxonomic orderBack to its clade in Plate 1

Chaetoderma nitidulum has 3,705 class-A GPCRs. The median for Caudofoveata is 2,512 across 2 species. It ranks 1 of 2 there and 1 of 593 in the atlas. This is 32.4 per 1,000 annotated genes.

91 of its receptors end with a named receptor family, 3,234 with a ligand type only, and 380 with no ligand type. Figure 1 places each of its ligand types among the other Caudofoveata species, and Figure 2 shows every receptor.

Known receptor family
Within the novelty threshold of a characterized receptor family.
New receptor family in a known ligand type
Within a known ligand type, but past the novelty threshold of every receptor family in it.
Ligand type known, receptor family unresolved
Assigned to a ligand type. The nearest receptor family is a catch-all group, so no receptor family is named.
Beyond all known ligand types
Past the novelty threshold of every known ligand type.
Ligand type known, receptor family call unreliable
Assigned to a ligand type. No receptor family is called, because in tests on characterized receptors left out of the reference set, most receptors assigned to the nearest receptor family belonged to other receptor families.
